meta.summary: I created a comprehensive high-level diagram for a personal website, breaking it down into 4 main areas: Pages (Home, About, Portfolio/Work, Contact), Design (visual elements and UX), Content (bio, skills, project descriptions), and Tech Stack (frontend frameworks, hosting, domain). The diagram also includes detailed breakdowns for key pages like the Home page structure and Portfolio requirements, plus a launch checklist with essential items like mobile responsiveness and SEO optimization, all interconnected to show how these components relate to each other.
